scripts.title: TDS Maps Simplifier
scripts.features:
[EN]
This is a simple script for tds. It can slightly increase your FPS during gameplay, but its primary purpose is to remove unnecessary models from the map, which should essentially make it easier to navigate. The script only displays the enemy path, the enemies themselves, units, and towers. Ground tower placements are marked in blue, while cliff tower placements (cliff towers like  Sniper, Ranger, or Spotlight Tech) are marked in purple.
The script only works on what's available in each map's workspace (for example, the Ground and Cliff folders, as well as folders containing towers, enemies, and units: NPCs, Towers, ClientUnits, and so on).
Is it universal for every map? Possibly; the script was primarily created with the goal of being a convenient "helper" for any map.
What about maps with multiple paths? I've taken that into account. The script simply scans the paths folder and applies the path selection script to each one found.

And yes, just a technical reminder: Early versions of the script removed collision from everything they could find in the workspace and created a platform for the player to walk on, which made most maps unplayable due to the tower placement area being inaccessible. My point: now a different method is used: a platform simply spawns under the player and moves behind them, preventing them from falling below a specified point. The platform isn't big, but it's not small either, so I recommend placing towers farther away from you when placing them, otherwise the platform underneath you simply won't let you do so.

[RU]
Просто скрипт для tds, по сути он может немного повысить ваш FPS во время игры, но по большей части скрипт сделан для удаления лишних моделей на карте, что по сути должно упростить ориентирование на ней. Скрипт оставляет только дорогу по которой идут враги, самих врагов, спавнящихся юнитов и башни. Синим цветом обозначены места для расстановки наземных башен, а фиолетовым цветом обозначены места для расстановки "Горных" башен (например Sniper, Ranger или Spotlight Tech)
Скрипт работает лишь на том что есть в воркспейсе каждой из карт, ( например папки Ground, Cliff, а так же папки в которых находятся башни враги и юниты: NPC's, Towers или ClientUnits и так далее ). 
Универсален ли он для каждой из карт? Возможно. В первую очередь скрипт создавался с упором на то что бы быть удобным "помощником" для любой карты.
Что на счет карт с несколькими путями? Я предусмотрел это. Скрипт просто сканирует папку с путями и применяет скрипт выделения путей для каждого найденого.

И да, просто техническое напоминание: Первые версии скрипта убирали коллизию у всего что только могли найти в воркспейсе и создавали платформу по которой игрок мог ходить, что делало большенство карт неиграбельными изза недоступности к зоне для расположения башен. К чему это я: сейчас используется другой метод, под игроком просто спавнится платформа которая передвигается за ним и не дает упасть ниже заданой точки. Платформа не большая но и не маленькая, поэтому я рекомендую при расстановке башен, ставить их по дальше от себя, иначе платформа находящаяся под вами просто не даст этого сделать

scripts.title: TDS script in Happy script
scripts.features:
✨ Tower Defense Simulator Script

This script for Tower Defense Simulator is currently in beta. Some features may still be under development and improvements will continue in future updates.

⚙️ The script is designed to work with low UNC exploits.
This means it avoids using advanced exploit functions that are not supported by many executors.

Because of this compatibility goal, the script does not support automatic tower placement recording.

🧠 Instead, the script uses a Build Program System that allows users to manually create structured tower build sequences and execute them automatically during gameplay.

📦 Build Program System

This system allows players to create a list of actions that will run automatically in order during the match.

📋 Program Actions

📍 Place
Place allows you to create a list of coordinates where towers will be placed automatically.
The system also supports selecting positions by clicking directly on locations in the map.

💰 Sell
Sell allows you to sell a specific tower manually or sell all towers of a selected type.

⬆️ Upgrade
Upgrade allows you to upgrade a specific tower to a chosen level.

🚀 Upgrade All
Upgrade All allows you to upgrade all towers of a selected type to a chosen level.

⏳ Wait
Wait pauses the program before the next action runs.
You can set the delay using seconds or wait until a specific wave is reached.

💾 Save and Load Programs

After building a program, you can export it using the Copy button.
This allows you to save the program text yourself.

Later, you can paste that program into the Load Program section and the system will automatically load and run the same build program again.

This makes it easy to share programs, reuse strategies, and avoid rebuilding the same program every time.

🎯 Using this Build Program System, players can design custom tower strategies and automate them in a reliable and flexible way.

🔧 More features and improvements may be added in future updates as the script continues development.

scripts.title: Better Auto TDS
scripts.script:
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local gui = script.Parent
local main = gui:WaitForChild("MainFrame")
local topBar = main:WaitForChild("TopBar")
local content = main:WaitForChild("Content")

-- 🔧 FIX VISIBILITY ISSUE
gui.Enabled = true
main.Visible = true

-- Tabs (pages)
local tabs = {
	Automation = content:WaitForChild("AutomationFrame"),
	Interactive = content:WaitForChild("InteractiveFrame"),
	Configuration = content:WaitForChild("ConfigurationFrame"),
	Settings = content:WaitForChild("SettingsFrame")
}

-- Buttons
local buttons = {
	Automation = topBar:WaitForChild("Automation"),
	Interactive = topBar:WaitForChild("Interactive"),
	Configuration = topBar:WaitForChild("Configuration"),
	Settings = topBar:WaitForChild("Settings")
}

local currentTab = "Automation"
local guiOpen = true

-- 🔁 SWITCH TAB FUNCTION
local function switchTab(tabName)
	currentTab = tabName

	for name, frame in pairs(tabs) do
		frame.Visible = (name == tabName)
	end

	-- highlight active tab
	for name, button in pairs(buttons) do
		if name == tabName then
			button.BackgroundTransparency = 0
			button.TextTransparency = 0
		else
			button.BackgroundTransparency = 0.6
			button.TextTransparency = 0.3
		end
	end
end

-- 🔘 CONNECT TAB BUTTONS
for name, button in pairs(buttons) do
	button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		switchTab(name)
	end)
end

-- 🎮 TAB KEY TOGGLE GUI
UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
	if gp then return end

	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Tab then
		guiOpen = not guiOpen
		main.Visible = guiOpen
	end
end)

-- =========================
-- 🧩 FEATURE CONTENT SETUP
-- =========================

-- AUTOMATION TAB
local auto = tabs.Automation

local autoLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
autoLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)
autoLabel.Text = "Automation Hub"
autoLabel.Parent = auto

local autoToggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
autoToggle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 40)
autoToggle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 60)
autoToggle.Text = "Auto Score: OFF"
autoToggle.Parent = auto

local autoEnabled = false
autoToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	autoEnabled = not autoEnabled
	autoToggle.Text = "Auto Score: " .. (autoEnabled and "ON" or "OFF")
end)

-- INTERACTIVE TAB
local inter = tabs.Interactive

local tpButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
tpButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 40)
tpButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
tpButton.Text = "Teleport Action"
tpButton.Parent = inter

tpButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local char = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
	if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
		char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)
	end
end)

-- CONFIGURATION TAB
local config = tabs.Configuration

local speedLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
speedLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 30)
speedLabel.Text = "Speed: 16"
speedLabel.Parent = config

local speed = 16

local speedUp = Instance.new("TextButton")
speedUp.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 40)
speedUp.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 40)
speedUp.Text = "+"
speedUp.Parent = config

speedUp.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	speed += 2
	speedLabel.Text = "Speed: " .. speed

	local char = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
	if char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
		char.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = speed
	end
end)

-- SETTINGS TAB
local settings = tabs.Settings

local resetButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
resetButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 40)
resetButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
resetButton.Text = "Reset Character"
resetButton.Parent = settings

resetButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local char = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
	if char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
		char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").Health = 0
	end
end)

-- DEFAULT TAB
switchTab("Automation")
